messages.subject: CPD seminar: W&I insurance on mid-market deals (19 Nov)
messages.plaintextBody:
Join our corporate know-how team for a lunchtime CPD seminar on warranty & indemnity insurance and how it's reshaping liability negotiations on mid-market M&A. Wednesday 19 November, 12:30, Boardroom 4. Sandwiches provided. 1 CPD hour.

WC Knowledge
